regions.full_page: God bless you Joseph J. - you and yours. Again many thanks for your kind favor of 4th - duly noted - as well as for the elastic bandages - was inclined to write electric and then came back the picture of the remarkably practical blanket of a couple years back you sent us. Thank God, while last year I did use it a short time, this year I never thought of such a thing. - not too bad a siga? Well .... best wishes and God's blessing to yourself and to all, especially our promising Texascan - Exile. Naturally if time and duty permitted I would not mind such an exile myself for a year or so .... Please don't forget us in your prayers to the Holy Ghost these days. That old essay problem still floats in my memory surface .. Now, I almost forgot: Some one from Knipe's Rest enrolled the family - parents and family of Rev Thomas J. lickugo - St. Francis de Paula Church, 7820 Dobson Ave. Chicago - and they did not know his parents names. I would appreciate it if you could let me know at your convenience the name of his Father. God bless you Joseph J. and Keep you. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
